title: What if you took a balloon to Mars?
caption:
This balloon would pop on its own on Mars. 🎈🔴

Mars' air is only about 0.6 % of Earth's (6.36 mbar, NASA). Anything sealed with Earth air inside pushes outward: snacks puff, bags bulge, gloves inflate. A tied balloon would try to swell over 100 times its volume (Boyle's law: ×116 to ×159 depending on temperature), so the latex tears long before.

The rip itself runs at about 570 m/s through stretched latex, more than twice the speed of sound on Mars (about 240 m/s, measured by NASA's Perseverance rover).
